name: Carthage
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Carthage, MO 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Carthage, Missouri for 2026: Sparkle in the Park, a light display, Merry Mondays, a parade and Santa, with dates and prices.
lede: Carthage lights Central Park with hundreds of thousands of handmade lights, drives families past a million more at a church light display, and fills its Mondays with Santa, a train and a parade on the square.
celebrates: Carthage Water and Electric Plant builds Sparkle in the Park by hand, and KOAM reported that the display holds more than 400,000 lights, about 26 miles of cord if stretched end to end. The Joplin Globe described a crowd of hundreds at the lighting ceremony, with a Santa sleigh and the Grinch posing for family photos. Vision Carthage runs the Hometown Holidays program, including Merry Mondays and the Mayor's downtown lighting. The Congregation of the Mother of the Redeemer offers its drive-thru light display, and Mercy Carthage welcomes children for train rides and reindeer. Most of these events are free.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap of Carthage's holiday events, so this page leans on the 2026 announcements. Those announcements count the seasons: CWEP calls 2026 the sixth annual Sparkle in the Park, so 2025 was the fifth, and the city calendar lists the Way of Salvation display as its 43rd annual, so 2025 was the 42nd. The Joplin Globe reported that the 2026 lighting ceremony drew a crowd of hundreds, and that the park stays lit every night from 5 pm to midnight.
facts: Carthage is the county seat of Jasper County and is nicknamed America's Maple Leaf City, after the Maple Leaf Festival that began in 1966 as a marching band competition and now draws more than 80,000 visitors each October, according to the city. The Jasper County Courthouse on the square was built of local Carthage stone in 1894 and 1895 and is on the National Register of Historic Places. Carthage limestone was polished into Carthage marble and used inside the Missouri State Capitol.
trains: Trains have a long history in Carthage, because the Missouri and Western Railway reached the town in 1872 and helped it grow into one of the most prosperous in the area. Today children can ride the train at the Mercy Carthage Magical Christmas Experience and the Kiwanis Christmas Train on Polar Express Night. The CPKC Holiday Train stops at Joplin Union Depot, and families can find that stop on our Joplin page.
traditions: Carthage Water and Electric Plant crews hand build the displays in Central Park, with more than 400,000 lights, a free admission and nightly hours.

Vision Carthage hosts Monday evening events through December, including a candy cane hunt, s'mores with Santa and Polar Express Night.

kidfact: Sparkle in the Park uses so many lights that, stretched end to end, the cords would run about 26 miles.
faq: The city lights Central Park with Sparkle in the Park, a display of more than 400,000 lights built by Carthage Water and Electric Plant crews. Vision Carthage hosts Merry Mondays and the Mayor's downtown lighting and parade on the square, and a church offers a drive-thru light display with more than one million lights.
Is Sparkle in the Park free?

Yes. Carthage Water and Electric Plant says the display is free and open to the public. The lights are on every night from 5 pm until midnight during the season, and the display is built by hand by the plant's own employees as a gift to the community.
What is the Way of Salvation Christmas Light Display?

It is a half-mile drive-thru display at the Congregation of the Mother of the Redeemer with more than one million lights and illuminated sculptures of Old and New Testament stories. The congregation has offered it since 1983, and the city calendar lists it as free, with donations accepted.
What are the Merry Mondays in Carthage?

Merry Mondays are Monday evening events run by Vision Carthage as part of Hometown Holidays. They include a candy cane hunt, s'mores with Santa at Kellogg Lake and a Polar Express movie night with the Kiwanis Christmas Train, and each one is free for families.
Is there a Christmas parade in Carthage?

Yes. The Mayor's Downtown Lighting Festivities include caroling, the lighting of the buildings on the Historic Carthage Square and a Christmas parade hosted by SkillsUSA. It is held each year on the first Monday of December, and watching a public parade is free.

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
